scope: Repair two independent findings against the aidream deploy-cadence watch; no real workflow dispatch, build, release, deployment, or product-health observation

repairs.test_only_classification: Both main push paths-ignore and Git runtime pathspec now exclude root and nested conftest.py. The existing schedule, 45-minute breach, no-active-deploy check, immutable release_ref, and watch concurrency remain unchanged.
repairs.behavioral_guard: The test extracts and runs the workflow's actual shell run body in a temporary Git repository with only date and gh as external doubles. It covers healthy recent dispatch, older code than last deploy start, active deploy, dry-run, eligible breach, immutable selected SHA, new issue, and existing-issue comment instead of duplicate issue creation. No GitHub endpoint is contacted.
repairs.documentation: The owning feature document now distinguishes deploy-workflow start cadence from production movement.

red_green.old_classifier: Both new classification checks fail against the previous workflow: conftest.py is absent from push exclusions and the Git pathspec selects it as latest runtime commit.
red_green.wrong_branch_mutant: A scratch copy replacing only the real breach condition with `if true; then` produced 2 failures (healthy and stale-code) and 4 passes in the six-scenario actual-shell guard. Shared source was untouched.
red_green.restored: Focused pytest: 10 passed; ruff check and format check passed; git diff --check passed.

bounded_limit: The watch reads newest deploy.yml startedAt without dispatch inputs. GitHub CLI run-list fields and REST workflow-run metadata expose event/title/jobs but not trusted workflow_dispatch input values; verify-only, candidate-report-only, and browser-image-only runs can reset this clock. A job/step inspection cannot prove ECS movement at run start, so this repair preserves the existing dispatch-start policy and explicitly documents that live deployed SHA and health must be checked separately. A newly dispatched run may also take time to appear in run-list; the active-run guard and workflow serialization are retained but are not a transactional deduplication proof.
